description: This file defines a Java interface for a repository managing Account entities in a Spring application, extending CrudRepository to provide CRUD operations and adding a custom method to find accounts by account number.

classes.name: AccountRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface for performing CRUD operations on Account objects, with a custom method to find accounts by account number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Method to retrieve an Optional containing an Account matching the given account number.
